UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing display name, avatar, and personal preferences

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

avatar.description: URL or base64 data URI of the user avatar picture

plan.description: Subscription tier of the user (e.g. Luna Plus)

customInstructions.description: Custom system instructions for AI personalization

searchGroundingDefault.description: Whether Google Search grounding is enabled by default

voiceGender.description: Preferred voice for live audio synthesis

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server time of last profile update

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: A conversation thread containing metadata and messages

createdAt.description: Timestamp in ms when thread was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp in ms when thread was last modified

isPinned.description: Whether thread is pinned to top of chat history

modelId.description: Selected model ID for this chat

category.description: Temporal category (e.g. Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 Days, Older)

messages.description: Array of messages in this thread

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and account preferences

/threads/{threadId}.description: Stores user chat history threads and conversations
